name: dam-sluice
description: M4 S14 scenario (epic #163 Phase 3b; objects beyond the house; issue #193): the Flood Control Dam #3 sluice gates. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The first sixteen commands are troll-combat's (the sword kills the troll at the third blow under this clock and seed), then `north` to the East-West Passage, `north` to the Deep Ravine, `down` to Reservoir South, `up` to the Deep Canyon, `east` to the Dam, `north` to the Dam Lobby and `north` to the Maintenance Room (the Loud Room route through the Echo Room is avoided: ECHO-ROOM reads its own input without a prompt). `take wrench`, back to the Dam, `turn bolt with wrench` refused ("The bolt won't turn with your best effort.": GATE-FLAG unset), back to the Maintenance Room, `push yellow button` ("Click.", GATE-FLAG T), back to the Dam, `look` (the green bubble glows), `turn bolt with wrench` (BOLT-FUNCTION 77act1.mud:701: "The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.", LOW-TIDE T, the trunk made visible), `look`, `south`, `nw` to the drained reservoir, `look`, `take trunk`, `north` across the reservoir bed (the LOW-TIDE exit) and `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference (captured twice, byte-identical transcripts). Command 23 enters the Maintenance Room, whose action MAINT-ROOM declares PRSO as the type PRSOBJ, defined in no 1977 source file; under the #98 ADR amendment (#193, INV-11 fixed) a still-undefined attached TYPE name is not enforced, as in pinned Confusion. Gated by tests/historical_dam_sluice_test.rkt (make test-m4-dam-sluice); see docs/evidence/M4/DAM-CLOCKS.md and S14-PRSOBJ-DECL.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
